svg.title: The parts of the simulator screen
svg.desc: Diagram of the Orbital insertion page. At the top, the title, the object list and the planet buttons. On the left, the map with the planet, the dashed green target band, the predicted trajectory in orange with the Pe and Ap points, and the command bar at the bottom. On the right, the panel with the chosen object, the mission, the telemetry, the fuel and the message box. Seven numbers point to each part, explained in the legend.
svg.text: The parts of the simulator screen
Three areas: choosing the mission, the map and the flight panel
Object: what you will put in orbit
Planet: the destination and record stars
Map: predicted trajectory and target band
Engines: hold the button or arrow key
Fuel, heat shield and help messages
